name: @openclinxr/physics-touch-contract
purpose: @openclinxr/physics-touch-contract Determinism contract for physics-compliant clinical touch.

exportSummaries.FIXED_DT: Fixed physics dt = 1/60 exactly as an f64 literal (C1).
exportSummaries.PhysicsCagematchReport: A cagematch report for a single physics engine candidate.
exportSummaries.StubPhysicsAdapter: Stub adapter for testing the contract layer.
exportSummaries.accumulateFrameTime: Advance the accumulator by `frameDt` seconds of render time.
exportSummaries.appendTickInput: Append a tick input to the log.
exportSummaries.buildDeterministicInputLog: Build a predictable input log for testing C6 determinism.
exportSummaries.buildPalpationInputLog: Build a deterministic palpation input log.
exportSummaries.buildPhysicsCagematchReport: Build a cagematch report from session parameters.
exportSummaries.computeSnapshotHash: Compute the SHA-256 hex digest of a serialized state buffer.
exportSummaries.consumeTick: Consume one physics tick, advancing the tick counter.
exportSummaries.createFixedStepAccumulator: Create a new fixed-step accumulator starting at tick 0.
exportSummaries.currentTick: Get the current tick without advancing.
exportSummaries.defaultNotEvidenceFor: Factory for the default notEvidenceFor list (C7).
exportSummaries.getTickInput: Get a tick input by tick index.
exportSummaries.hashState: Compute SHA-256 from a state object in one call: serialize → sha256 → hex.
exportSummaries.inputLogLength: Get the total number of entries in the log.
exportSummaries.listTickInputs: Get a read-only snapshot of all entries, sorted by tick.
exportSummaries.replayFromSnapshot: Replay from a restored snapshot at tick k, then continue replaying the remaining input log entries (tick > k).
exportSummaries.replayInputLog: Replay an input log against a physics adapter.
exportSummaries.runMeasuredMetrics: Run the real Rapier engine through palpation and passive-rom scenarios, measure timing and stability metrics, and return a fully populated report.
exportSummaries.runThreeWayCagematch: Run the three-way cagematch: Havok, Rapier, Jolt against the same log.
exportSummaries.serializeState: Serialize a JSON-serializable state object to a deterministic byte buffer.
